# Vendored Activepieces builder

Source: https://github.com/activepieces/activepieces
Commit: 8dc5a91726f63e68ff062501b7198510ae53153e
License: MIT (all vendored content lives outside the upstream `packages/ee/`
directory; see LICENSE in this directory for the upstream license text).

## Layout

| Directory           | Upstream path                    |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `core-utils/`       | `packages/core/utils/src`        |
| `piece-types/`      | `packages/core/piece-types/src`  |
| `execution/`        | `packages/core/execution/src`    |
| `shared/`           | `packages/core/shared/src`       |
| `pieces-framework/` | `packages/pieces/framework/src`  |
| `web/`              | `packages/web/src`               |

## Local changes

Files are kept as close to upstream as possible. Mechanical rewrites applied
to every file:

- Import specifiers: `@/...` aliases and `@activepieces/*` package names are
  rewritten to relative paths; relative imports get explicit `.js` extensions
  (nodenext); `radix-ui` imports become scoped `@radix-ui/react-*` imports;
  `semver` subpath imports become named imports.
- Server/API, i18n, router, socket, dnd-kit and other app-infrastructure
  imports are redirected to the modules in `../shims/`.
- `type` qualifiers were added to imports where required by
  `verbatimModuleSyntax`.

Files replaced with local stubs or trimmed barrels carry a `ph:`/`ph-stub:`/
`ph-replacement:` header comment. Trimmed barrels drop upstream surfaces the
vendored builder does not use (ee, auth, workers, engine operations). The
`execution/lib/engine/stream-step-progress.ts` leaf breaks an upstream
runtime import cycle.

Do not edit files here by hand — they are regenerated by the vendoring
script; put changes in shims or stub overrides instead.
